pd_proxy_settings.mu100_status: Sensitivity assumptions only. These are not observation-specific flight-calibrated values.

angle_settings.status: The fitted modulation phase is reported. It is not labelled as official polarization angle because the release did not provide a verified phase-to-PA convention or offset.

scientific_limits.background_subtraction_status: Empirical mean blank-sky Q/U vector comparison only; not the official POLIX background-subtraction pipeline.
scientific_limits.required_warning: PD values shown by the application are sensitivity proxies and must not be interpreted as final calibrated astrophysical polarization measurements.
